<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="semantic-recipes">
<h1>Semantic recipes</h1>
<p>Semantic recipes package typed pyjev decisions with deterministic input preparation and result interpretation. They are ordinary Python APIs, not a second transport client. Recipe plans can be inspected without credentials or network access; execution uses the caller’s existing <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Jev</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AsyncJev</span></code> instance. Recipes preserve their underlying typed results so callers can inspect probability distributions, confidence, usage, model, request ID, and raw response data.</p>
<p>Thresholds and actions are caller policy. The examples below use illustrative defaults, not universal correctness thresholds. Calibrate against representative local data and account for the consequences of each action.</p>
<section id="find-rank-and-independently-test-applicability">
<h2>Find: rank and independently test applicability</h2>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">find</span></code> to rank candidate documents or records while separately asking whether any candidate actually answers the query. The Choice ranking alone always has a winner, so it must not be treated as proof that a match exists.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Jev</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev.recipes</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Candidate</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">build_find</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">execute_find</span>

<span class="n">candidates</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
    <span class="n">Candidate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;auth&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;API-key resolution and credential precedence.&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="n">Candidate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;client&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Retry behavior in the TypeSafe client.&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="n">Candidate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;release&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Release process and version tagging.&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">]</span>

<span class="n">plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">build_find</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;Where is retry behavior configured?&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">candidates</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">top_k</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">found_at</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.70</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">absent_below</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.35</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_dict</span><span class="p">())</span>  <span class="c1"># inspect exact state, question specification, and local policy</span>

<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">Jev</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">execute_find</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exists_verdict</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;answered&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">use</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">hits</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span>
<span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exists_verdict</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;partial&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">inspect_more</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">search_elsewhere</span><span class="p">()</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">find</span></code> creates one <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BundleDecision</span></code> with a Choice over candidate IDs (and an explicit no-candidate option) plus an independent Noul applicability judgment. It makes one SDK request. The default result ordering is descending Choice probability, with ties kept in candidate input order. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">exists_verdict</span></code> is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">answered</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">partial</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">absent</span></code>, based only on the Noul probability and caller-supplied thresholds. Even an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">absent</span></code> verdict retains its ranked hits and the complete <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BundleResult</span></code> under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result.decision</span></code>.</p>
<p>Provide an ordered list or tuple of 1–254 candidates. Candidate IDs must be unique and match <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,63}</span></code>; candidate text must be nonempty. The additional Choice option accounts for the 255-option SDK cardinality bound. Invalid queries, IDs, thresholds, and cardinalities fail before the client is called.</p>
<p>The query and every candidate’s ID and text are included in the request state. Inspect <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan.state</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan.to_dict()</span></code> before execution when privacy or request size matters. There is no silent truncation; callers should bound text and candidate count before calling the recipe. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">afind</span></code> / <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">aexecute_find</span></code> provide equivalent native-async operation.</p>
</section>
<section id="planning-execution-and-interpretation">
<h2>Planning, execution, and interpretation</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build_find</span></code> is deterministic and credential-free. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">execute_find</span></code> performs the API call; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">interpret_find</span></code> can be tested with a synthetic <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BundleResult</span></code> without network access. This split makes request shape, interpretation rules, and call count independently testable.</p>
</section>
<section id="policy-and-limitations">
<h2>Policy and limitations</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>The probability distribution ranks candidates; a top candidate is not by itself a found/not-found signal.</p></li>
<li><p>Thresholds should be calibrated locally. Confidence and probability values are model signals, not guarantees of correctness.</p></li>
<li><p>The recipe never opens a path, fetches a URL, or dispatches a handler.</p></li>
<li><p>Returned evidence can support application review; it is not a citation guarantee or a substitute for inspecting source material.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="extract-deterministic-literal-candidates">
<h2>Extract: deterministic literal candidates</h2>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">extract</span></code> only to disambiguate literal values already found by deterministic Python logic. Jev selects among supplied values or an explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">none</span></code> option; it cannot generate a new value.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Jev</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev.recipes</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">extract</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">regex_field</span>

<span class="n">field</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">regex_field</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">name</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;invoice&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">pattern</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="sa">r</span><span class="s2">&quot;INV-\d+&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">description</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;the invoice number&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">normalizer</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="k">lambda</span> <span class="n">value</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">value</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">removeprefix</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;INV-&quot;</span><span class="p">)),</span>
    <span class="n">max_candidates</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">32</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">Jev</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">extract</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">document</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">invoice_text</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">fields</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">field</span><span class="p">],</span>
        <span class="n">min_confidence</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.85</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="c1"># caller policy; calibrate for your use case</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">invoice</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">fields</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">&quot;invoice&quot;</span><span class="p">]</span>
<span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">invoice</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">action</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;auto&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">persist</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">invoice</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">normalized_value</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">invoice</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">action</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;review&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;none&quot;</span><span class="p">}:</span>
    <span class="n">human_review</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">invoice</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">source_value</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">invoice</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">decision</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Regex matches are deduplicated exactly and kept in source order. Every nonempty field produces one Choice in a shared bundle, with stable candidate IDs and an explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">none</span></code> option. Fields with no matches are omitted from the request; if every field is empty, extraction returns <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">no_candidates</span></code> outcomes and makes zero API calls. Candidate caps are explicit per field (default 64, maximum 254); exceeding a cap fails locally rather than silently truncating.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_value</span></code> is the exact selected literal, while <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">normalized_value</span></code> is produced by the caller’s deterministic normalizer. A normalizer exception or non-JSON-compatible output yields <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">action=&quot;review&quot;</span></code>, retains the source literal and Choice evidence, and omits the normalized value; exception details are not exposed. Without an explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">min_confidence</span></code>, successful candidate selections default to review rather than automatic action. A below-threshold selection likewise returns review with the original distribution and confidence preserved. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">aextract</span></code> provides native async execution.</p>
<p>The full document and candidate literals are included in request state. Inspect <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build_extract(...).to_dict()</span></code> before execution if the document contains sensitive data or may exceed your request budget.</p>
</section>
<section id="verify-support-contradiction-or-no-coverage">
<h2>Verify: support, contradiction, or no coverage</h2>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">verify</span></code> to judge explicit claims against caller-supplied evidence. It deliberately distinguishes contradiction from evidence that says nothing: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">supports</span></code> maps to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">verified</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">contradicts</span></code> to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">contradicted</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">says_nothing</span></code> to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">unsupported</span></code>. Unsupported does not mean false.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Jev</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev.recipes</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">verify</span>

<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">Jev</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">report</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">verify</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">claims</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span>
            <span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;compat&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;The public API remains backwards compatible.&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
            <span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;transport&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;The change adds a second provider.&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="p">],</span>
        <span class="n">evidence</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span>
            <span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;diff&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">diff_text</span><span class="p">),</span>
            <span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;api-docs&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">api_docs</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="p">],</span>
        <span class="n">auto_accept</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.85</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="c1"># optional, caller-owned policy</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">item</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">report</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">results</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">item</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">claim_id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">verdict</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">confidence</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">probabilities</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">action</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">report</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">summary</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_dict</span><span class="p">())</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Independent relation questions for claims—and optional evidence-source selection questions when more than one source is supplied—are sent in one bundle request. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">auto_accept</span></code> never changes the verdict: it only permits <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">action=&quot;auto_accept&quot;</span></code> for a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">verified</span></code> result that meets the caller threshold (and has a confidently selected source when multiple sources were supplied). Contradicted, unsupported, unselected-source, and below-threshold results remain available for review with their original typed Choice results.</p>
<p>Plain claim/evidence strings receive deterministic positional IDs; use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Claim</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Evidence</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">(id,</span> <span class="pre">text)</span></code> pairs for stable caller IDs. IDs are validated and passed through exactly. Plans accept up to 64 claims by default (configurable lower, capped at 64) and 254 evidence sources; over-limit input fails locally instead of silently chunking. The supplied evidence text is included in request state. The recipe does not fetch URLs, guarantee citations, or modify files. Inspect <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build_verify(...).to_dict()</span></code> before execution when request content or size needs review. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">averify</span></code> is the native async counterpart.</p>
</section>
<section id="classify-single-label-multiple-labels-and-other">
<h2>Classify: single label, multiple labels, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">other</span></code></h2>
<p>For one label, use a closed-set Choice; request the explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">other</span></code> option when items outside the taxonomy are meaningful. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">min_confidence</span></code> is caller policy. Without it, a single-label result reports <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">action=&quot;review&quot;</span></code> rather than implying an automatic action. Multi-label classification is not a Choice: it bundles one independent Noul per label and requires both <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">positive_at</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">negative_below</span></code>; the band between them is returned as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">unclear</span></code>.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Jev</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev.recipes</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Label</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">build_classify</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">execute_classify</span>

<span class="n">plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">build_classify</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;classify this support ticket&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">Label</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;billing&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Payment and invoice issues&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">Label</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;technical&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Product failures&quot;</span><span class="p">)],</span>
    <span class="n">include_other</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">min_confidence</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.90</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="c1"># local policy, calibrated for this workflow</span>
    <span class="n">model</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;typesafe-model-version&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_dict</span><span class="p">())</span>  <span class="c1"># inspect labels, state, questions, and thresholds</span>
<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">Jev</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">execute_classify</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">action</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;review&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">send_to_human</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">action</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;other&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">use_other_queue</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">decision</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">use_label</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">selected_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build_classify(...,</span> <span class="pre">mode=&quot;multi&quot;,</span> <span class="pre">positive_at=...,</span> <span class="pre">negative_below=...)</span></code> produces a bundle of independent judgments; any number of labels can be positive. If taxonomy levels depend on a prior answer, walk them explicitly in application code and retain each step result—the next valid option set requires another request. The recipe does not hide that request cost.</p>
</section>
<section id="match-same-unclear-or-different">
<h2>Match: same, unclear, or different</h2>
<p>Entity matching uses three categorical Choice outcomes. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">unclear</span></code> is a real semantic result, not an intermediate Score value. Without <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">min_confidence</span></code>, every result remains <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">action=&quot;review&quot;</span></code>; a supplied threshold can yield <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">auto_match</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">auto_different</span></code>, while <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">unclear</span></code> always remains review.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Jev</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev.recipes</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">build_match</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">execute_match</span>

<span class="n">plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">build_match</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;Alice Smith, 1 Main St&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;A. Smith, 1 Main Street&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">min_confidence</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.92</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="c1"># caller-owned</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">Jev</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">execute_match</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">action</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;auto_match&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">link_records</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">action</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;review&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">inspect</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">decision</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">probabilities</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="route-propose-a-handler-never-invoke-it">
<h2>Route: propose a handler, never invoke it</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">RouteHandler</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">RouteArgument</span></code> are descriptions, not imports or callbacks. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build_route</span></code> creates one handler Choice plus speculative closed-set argument Choices for every supplied handler in one bounded bundle. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">__none__</span></code> abstains from routing; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">__unspecified__</span></code> preserves a missing argument. Only the chosen handler’s argument answers are projected into the proposal, while the complete bundle remains available for review.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Jev</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev.recipes</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">RouteArgument</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">RouteHandler</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">build_route</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">execute_route</span>

<span class="n">handlers</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
    <span class="n">RouteHandler</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="s2">&quot;refund&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s2">&quot;Start a refund request&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">RouteArgument</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;reason&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Refund reason&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;duplicate&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;not_received&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;other&quot;</span><span class="p">)),),</span>
    <span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="n">RouteHandler</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;tracking&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Look up shipment status&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
<span class="n">plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">build_route</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">message</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">handlers</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_dict</span><span class="p">())</span>  <span class="c1"># includes request text and every allowed argument value</span>
<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">Jev</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">proposal</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">execute_route</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">proposal</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">status</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;proposed&quot;</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">proposal</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">arguments_complete</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">application_dispatch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">proposal</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">handler_id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">proposal</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">arguments</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># caller-owned effect</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The recipe never calls <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">application_dispatch</span></code>, imports a handler, or decides whether a proposal is authorized. Inspect request content before sending; speculative arguments for unselected handlers are still part of the model request. Oversized specs fail locally instead of being truncated.</p>
</section>
<section id="rerank-independent-relevance-judgments">
<h2>Rerank: independent relevance judgments</h2>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">rerank</span></code> when zero, one, or many candidates can be relevant. Unlike <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">find</span></code>, candidates do not compete in one normalized Choice distribution and there is no separate existence question: each candidate receives an independent Noul. The plan splits candidates into deterministic chunks of at most 64, executes chunks sequentially, preserves input order in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">results</span></code>, and sorts <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ranked</span></code> by descending relevance probability with input order as the tie-break. The hard plan cap is 4096 candidates; no candidate is silently dropped.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Jev</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev.recipes</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">RerankCandidate</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">build_rerank</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">execute_rerank</span>

<span class="n">plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">build_rerank</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;Which pages explain retry behavior?&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">RerankCandidate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;client&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">client_doc</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">RerankCandidate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;guide&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">guide_doc</span><span class="p">)],</span>
    <span class="n">chunk_size</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">64</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">min_relevance</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.72</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="c1"># optional caller policy</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">Jev</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">execute_rerank</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">item</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ranked</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">item</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">probability</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">relevant</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">min_relevance=None</span></code> leaves each <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">relevant</span></code> field unset; probabilities and all per-chunk typed decisions are still preserved. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">rerank</span></code> is multiple independent judgments, while <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">find</span></code> is competition plus an independent existence judgment.</p>
</section>
<section id="screen-an-advisory-semantic-prefilter">
<h2>Screen: an advisory semantic prefilter</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">screen</span></code> is a heuristic recipe, not a prompt-injection defense or security boundary. The caller must supply all thresholds through <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ScreenPolicy</span></code>. The deterministic outcome precedence is: high instruction signal → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">block</span></code>; low substance or relevance → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">skip</span></code>; adequate substance plus relevance → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pass</span></code>; otherwise <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">review</span></code>. Every signal probability and Noul result is returned, and no client-side gate is installed.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Jev</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev.recipes</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">ScreenPolicy</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">build_screen</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">execute_screen</span>

<span class="n">policy</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ScreenPolicy</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">instruction_block_at</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.80</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">substantive_skip_below</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.20</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">relevance_skip_below</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.15</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">relevance_pass_at</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.75</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">build_screen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">untrusted_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;summarize a release note&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">policy</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">policy</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_dict</span><span class="p">())</span>  <span class="c1"># inspect sensitive state and caller policy</span>
<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">Jev</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">advisory</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">execute_screen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">advisory</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">outcome</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;block&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;review&quot;</span><span class="p">}:</span>
    <span class="n">apply_application_review_policy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">advisory</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>A <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pass</span></code> means only that these particular heuristic signals crossed the supplied thresholds. It does not make untrusted content safe. Calibrate against local examples, preserve false-positive/false-negative review, and never use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">screen</span></code> as the sole security control.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
